data.name: Ujjayant
data.long_meaning: Ujjayant means 'conquering' or 'victorious' in Sanskrit. It is derived from the root words 'ud' (up, superior) and 'jay' (victory).

data.cultural_impact: The name Ujjayant holds a significant cultural impact in Hinduism, as it symbolizes the idea of striving for success and achievement in life. It is a powerful name that evokes feelings of determination, triumph, and courage. Ujjayant is a name that inspires individuals to overcome challenges and conquer their personal obstacles.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Ujjayant holds great significance in Hinduism as it represents the victorious journey of the soul towards self-realization and enlightenment. The name reminds us that each one of us has the potential to overcome our inner demons and spiritual challenges, and to conquer the final enemy, which is our own ego. Ujjayant is a name that encourages us to keep striving for spiritual growth and to never give up on our spiritual journey, no matter how difficult it may be.

historical_references.reference: Ujjain was the ancient capital of the Avanti Mahajanapada, located in present-day Madhya Pradesh, India. The city was known as Ujjayini during the Buddhist era and Ujjayant during the medieval period.
